race.description: Elders Coast And Country Mdn Plate
race.comment: The exposed form is plain so the first starters get their chances. The pick of them is the Ryan/Alexiou-trained LATTERAGH (11) who won her latest trial by a good space at Rosehill. By Trapeze Artist and is a half-sister to Hong Kong Group 1 winner Invincible Sage. Looks to have some of the family ability. PYRA (7) started at $2.50 on debut last start over 1200m at Kembla but after racing handy wilted late. Worth another chance coming back in trip on a tighter circuit. EXTREME COURAGE (3) recorded his fourth minor placing last time out when a closing third over this course and distance. Lacks the potential of other runners so one for the exotics only. GERYON (6) showed pace but weakened over 1200m at Kembla last time. In the mix. GABRESKI (5) Ace High gelding from Skywards on debut. Ran third at recent trial. Respect.
